//: Pack contributions to harness-core sockets (TN-26-005). The core owns the mechanisms; this file owns the TypeScript pack's content. specTechNouns feeds the phase gate's Intake check (ADR LEG-2026-032): non-blessed API frameworks and schema engines that must not survive intake into a spec body. contractFileSuffixes feeds the core's ticket-design, path-gate and phase-gate contract recognition (ADR LEG-2026-052): the filename suffix that marks a design contract in a project composing this pack.
//projectConfigSyncCommand: Which of this pack's projectCommands restores the project's generated config (ADR LEG-2026-072). The team lead runs it as `bounded lead sync-config <issue>`, in that ticket's own worktree, only after the user agrees; exactly one composed pack may name one.
//projectSetup: Project dependency setup sockets (ADR LEG-2026-051, ADR LEG-2026-062). projectSetupCommands are argv lists the host entry runs in order, without a shell, in the project root; each must install only from the committed lockfile and never run the project package's own lifecycle scripts: no role may write package.json (ADR LEG-2026-054), and refusing its scripts keeps that true even for a hand edit the drift check has not yet seen. A frozen Bun install refuses a bun.lock that does not match the manifests. projectSetupProbes are project-relative paths that exist only after those commands succeed: node_modules/.bun is the store Bun's isolated installs link every package from, checked against bun 1.3.14. The linker is named because Bun picks it by the tree, not the manifest: a project whose `workspaces` globs match no directory yet (every new project, before its design) installs hoisted and leaves no .bun; neither `bun install --lockfile-only` nor a failed resolution creates it. projectIgnoreRules are .gitignore lines for what setup and builds produce. The core accepts only root-anchored rules with a literal first segment, so the per-workspace node_modules and dist directories are ignored by the pack that owns the workspace layout.
//projectCheckCommands: The project's full check, as argv lists run in order without a shell in the project root (ADR LEG-2026-066). `bounded lead merge` runs it on main after merging a ticket, undoes the merge when it fails, and pushes only when it passes.
//runtimeBuiltinModules: The runtime's own modules, which no package provides: `bun` and every `bun:` module (bun:test, bun:sqlite). bounded init's scan of the harness it copies skips them when it lists the packages that harness depends on, as the core skips its own runtime's node: modules.
//projectManifest: projectManifestScripts are pack-relative scripts the project initializer runs (node, project dir and harness source root as argv, then optionally the project name) after it writes its own files (ADR LEG-2026-051): this pack writes the project's package manifests, its generated tsconfig.json and its bun.lock (ADR LEG-2026-061, ADR LEG-2026-062). The script reads projectPackageTemplate (exactly one across the composition), every composed pack's projectScripts and pins, and the workspaceTemplates and adapterTechnologies sockets.
//layout: Layout sockets (ADRs LEG-2026-057 and LEG-2026-058; TN-26-012 sections 7 and 8). testFileSuffixes make a file under a source root test-side: the tests themselves (`.spec.*`, `_test.*` and `_spec.*` too, because bun collects them as tests, so no other role may write one; the gates also hand bun only test-side files, by path), the shared store conformance suites, and bun's snapshot files (`__snapshots__/<test file>.snap`), which are expected values the builder must neither read nor write; run_tests also runs bun with CI=true so a run never writes one. generatedFileGlobs: the generated law suites, which only generators write.
//projectConfig: Project configuration is generated, never written by a role (ADR LEG-2026-054, ADR LEG-2026-061). pins, projectScripts and projectCheckScripts feed scripts/project-package.ts: ts-morph is pinned because the delivered surface check needs it, and check:surface is folded into the generated check so delivery finds the manifest already wired. Shipped scripts run with bun (ADR LEG-2026-062). projectCheckScripts are script names folded into `check` in composition order. projectShippedFiles (project path to pack-relative source) are copied verbatim at init, so the surface checker check:surface runs exists from the start. projectNestedConfigNames are file-name globs that count as config at any depth: Bun and the type-checker read the nearest package.json, tsconfig and bunfig.toml for each file, so a nested one is drift unless it is a generated workspace manifest or a file a composed generator owns, and the path policy refuses every role a write to one. projectDependencyDirs are the directory names installed dependencies resolve from: expected only at the project root and directly under a generated workspace directory, where Bun's isolated installs link each workspace's dependencies; anywhere else one is drift and write-denied for every role, because Bun, the type-checker and the bundler resolve it before the root's. projectConfigNames are root file-name globs that count as project config for this stack: scripts/project-config.ts refuses at the phase gates when any of them differs from, is missing from, or is not produced by what the composed packs generate; `bounded lead sync-config <issue>` (the lead's command, in a ticket worktree, after the user agrees) rewrites them. The other package managers' lockfiles stay listed, because Bun migrates from one when bun.lock is missing.
